topic: Promo: behind the scenes of the animated video line, station by station, and what the buyer supplies
title: INSIDE THE LINE
ONE EPISODE, BUILT

script.text: Making an animated video by hand is a pile of small jobs.
Now picture a factory line. One topic line goes in at the left.
First station, the script. Your writing key turns the line into narration.
Second station, the voice. Your voice key records it, and every word gets a time.
Third station, the shot list. Cuts land on the spoken words, and shot sizes keep changing.
Fourth station, the frames. Every picture is drawn in code, then animated.
Fifth station, the sound. Ticks, whooshes and a music bed are built to match the cuts.
Last station, the master. The mix is levelled so the whole video sounds even.
And a finished video rolls off the end of the line, ready to upload.
You get the engine, the cast, the sets, the scripts and the guides.
You bring your own keys for the voice and the writing. No keys come inside.
One line in, one finished video out. Get the full system. Link in the about section.

science.claim: Making an animated video by hand is a pile of small jobs.
science.working: Opinion, not a statistic. No figure is stated or implied.

science.claim: One topic line goes in and one finished video comes out.
science.working: The pipeline takes a topic line and produces a mastered video through script, voice, shot list, frames, sound and master stages.
science.source: brief promo1108a, topic and pack sections

science.claim: The voice is recorded and every spoken word gets a time. Cuts land on spoken words.
science.working: voice builds words.json with the time of every spoken word. plan turns cue words into frames, a word cut landing 2 frames before the word.
science.source: brief promo1108a, what the VM does with your files and edit rules

science.claim: Frames are drawn in code, sound is built to match, and the mix is levelled.
science.working: Scenes are SVG animated with Remotion. sound generates each clip once and places events. master levels the mix to a fixed loudness. No figure is stated.
science.source: brief promo1108a, intro and what the VM does with your files

science.claim: The buyer gets the engine, cast, sets, scripts and guides, and supplies their own voice and writing keys. No keys are included.
science.working: The kit holds the engine, cast, sets and scripts, with reference guides. The brief states the buyer supplies their own keys and none are included.
science.source: brief promo1108a, topic and kit reference sections

whoosh: a short soft airy whoosh transition, no voices
chime: a bright short confirmation chime, two soft notes
select_draw: a quick digital selection sound, a soft rising electronic shimmer as a box is drawn on screen, short
